body.label: Target
body.html: One detected enemy within 4 units that can perceive you.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target has -1 on its next Success Die against anyone other than you until the start of your next turn. You gain +1 Fortitude against it during that time.

surges.html: On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Vow
rider.html: Vow: do not voluntarily move farther from the target before your next turn. If kept, spend this Authority when it attacks you to resist 1 unit of forced movement; breaking the Vow discards it.
